mentions.name: OBA Cloud
mentions.description: A managed services offering that helps transit agencies adopt and run the open source OneBusAway transit software, turning what used to require a month-long engagement with a transit consulting firm into a 15 minute, wizard-driven process. Recent additions include broadcasting critical alerts to all riders in the system via push notification, support for Live Activities on iOS, and hosting for four new public transit systems.
mentions.problem: The open source transit software has historically been beloved by users but a real pain to set up and maintain, previously requiring a month-long engagement with a transit consulting firm.
mentions.source_excerpt: Through the non-profit that collectively owns OBA, I've been working on a managed services offering to help transit agencies adopt the software, which has historically been beloved by users, but a real pain to set up and maintain. The software, cleverly named OBA Cloud, turns what used to require a month-long engagement with a transit consulting firm into a 15 minute, wizard-driven process.
mentions.author: aaronbrethorst
